simple.meaning: גָּדִישׁ (gâdîysh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גָּדִישׁ (H1430) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 22:5, with occurrences in Exodus, Judges, Job.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּדִישׁ (H1430) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גָּדִישׁ (H1430) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גָּדִישׁ (gâdîysh) / H1430 is traced through Exodus 22:5, Judges 15:5, Job 5:26, Job 21:32 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: a stack of sheaves; by analogy, a tomb
definitions.full: H1430. gadiysh I. גָּדִישׁ noun masculine Job 5:26 heap, stack (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic id. ) — גָּדִישׁ Exod 22:5 3 t.; — stack of sheaves 22:5 ; Judg 15:5 (|| קָמָה in both) Job 5:26 . II. גּדשׁ (= *; exact meaning unknown). II. גָּדִישׁ noun [masculine] tomb (Arabic id. ) Job 21:32 ; Dr § 178, ed. 3, p. 229 suggests reading גֶּדֶשׁ .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to heap up);
